Class StaffInfo

java.lang.Object
org.csystem.util.datasource.staff.StaffInfo
public class StaffInfo extends Object
Represents a staff member with identity, dates, and a rest day.

Uses a fluent setter API (each setter returns this) to enable method chaining.
